children: Carriage Services terminated its Equity Distribution Agreement for an at-the-market offering of up to $100 million on Oct 4, 2026, with Oppenheimer & Co. and Raymond James & Associates. The early termination carries no penalties, and the company had not sold any shares under the program. Management indicated limited immediate impact to liquidity or dilution and retains flexibility to consider alternative financing options.
